title: Country guess validation
body:
- Countrydle and continental games reject unknown text and mismatched country names and IDs before recording a guess or consuming an attempt.
- Canonical and official country names are matched exactly, ignoring case and surrounding whitespace; wildcard text and blank guesses are rejected.
- Questions beginning with do are recognized in the Guess input and redirected to the Question tab with a notice rather than submitted as guesses.
- Guest synchronization uses the same country validator.

This release retains the desktop map/question-focus fix and persistent disk-backed caches from the previously prepared releases. Saved player progress and game limits are unchanged.
